name: btc_regime_sizing_risk_first_20260808
created: 2026-08-08 (written before any risk-metric was computed for the unread maps)
line: regime-conditioned SIZING overlay on the promoted swingtransition stack, judged on RISK
why: The PnL-first version of this line (docs Part 3) selected czz_trend on VAL and took one OOS read: gated PnL +7.17% vs the baseline's +10.76%, so it missed a PnL bar and was not adopted -- but its MDD improved from -12.41% to -7.72% and its worst quarter from -0.87% to -2.71%. The literature's own use of regimes is exposure reduction, not direction (Shu & Kolm 2024 report the jump-model allocation's headline as max drawdown -55.2% -> -24.5% with return roughly unchanged). This contract re-poses the question with risk as the objective it was always suited to.
honest_constraints: NO virgin holdout exists. czz_trend's 2026 window (Q1-Q3) was already read under the PnL contract, so a fresh single-read referee is not available and pretending otherwise would be dishonest.

The maps are FIXED rules with no fitted parameters (multipliers and thresholds are literals), so the project's frozen-rule protocol applies: evaluate across K non-overlapping periods and judge CONSISTENCY, rather than take one more window. This is the same reasoning used in research_btc_h48qual_sigma9regime_lowo_verified_20260802.py.

Trade counts are small: 10-14 gated trades on VAL and 41 on OOS, ~51 total. Any single-period risk number is noise. That is why the primary evidence is a bootstrap distribution plus per-period consistency, not a point estimate.
Replaying the five maps that were never read on OOS is a new measurement. It happens ONCE, in a single pass, under this contract, with no iteration afterwards.
candidate_definition: unchanged from scripts/research_btc_swingtransition_regime_sizing_overlay_20260808.py -- sidecar margin_fraction multiplied by a fixed per-regime multiplier looked up at the ENTRY-SIGNAL bar. Total budget scale, entries, exits and the futures sizing contract (notional = margin x leverage) are untouched.

metrics.primary: max drawdown of the gated equity path (less negative is better)

evaluation_protocol.periods: four natural calendar periods spanning the full ledger: VAL 2025Q4, OOS 2026Q1, 2026Q2, 2026Q3-partial
evaluation_protocol.bootstrap: stationary block bootstrap over the trade sequence, B=2000, mean block length 5 trades, applied to the combined ledger; reports P(map MDD better than identity) and the Calmar distribution
evaluation_protocol.note: the bootstrap resamples trades, so it measures how much of the observed risk difference survives reordering/resampling -- it does not manufacture new out-of-sample evidence

adoption_gates.gate_1_consistency: map MDD better than identity in >= 3 of the 4 calendar periods
adoption_gates.gate_2_bootstrap: P(map MDD better than identity) >= 0.70 over B=2000 resamples
adoption_gates.gate_3_pnl_guardrail: total PnL >= 60% of identity's total PnL
adoption_gates.gate_4_not_by_starvation: trade count within 20% of identity's (a map must reduce risk by RESIZING, not by quietly refusing to trade)

if_adopted: the map becomes a RISK overlay recommendation on the promoted stack, recorded as such. It is NOT a claim of higher PnL -- the PnL-first contract already rejected that. Live wiring would still require the usual promotion audit.
if_none_passes: the risk axis is closed for this overlay family and the promoted stack keeps its current sizing.

fresh_forward.note: ledgers are OUTPUTS of the causal replay and are used only for metric computation, never as model input
